page.overview:
Who is Fionna Lookalike?

An unnamed human was briefly seen in "Cake the Cat". Cake initially believed she was Fionna, but upon seeing her from the front he saw her face was deformed and covered in purple welts.

She looks almost the same as Fionna in her uniform. She is a blonde, corpulent woman, in a white and brown uniform, but her face is partially purple and deformed.
